tool_signatures.name: beginReceiptApproval
tool_signatures.description:
Begins the EP-APPROVAL-v1 reference flow for the single supported
`payment.release` action profile. The server validates the closed
challenge and action, recomputes their exact action hash and
`payment.release.1` CAID, and creates a Class-A human review ceremony.
The caller supplies a tenant-bound Cloud bearer key with the
`approval_request` capability or `admin`; credentials discovered in a
challenge or manifest are never accepted.

A successful response is always HTTP 201 and never carries a receipt.
Its status is `pending` for a usable request. An exact idempotent retry
after the fixed approval window may return the same request and poll
capabilities with status `expired`.

tool_signatures.name: consumeCloudApprovalPrototype
tool_signatures.description:

`executing_system` to `emilia_cloud_approval_endpoint`; callers cannot
override it. A consumed receipt cannot be reused.

Consumption records one-time authorization use; this prototype route
does not itself move money. Requires a tenant-bound Cloud bearer key
with `approval_request` or `admin`.

This route is not a production API, is not a certification program,
and is not an interoperability claim.

are consumed only by the separate atomic activation endpoint.

approval challenge, `execute` reserves one evidence use and provider

tool_signatures.name: createAgentRecord
tool_signatures.description:
Reads and verifies the immutable signed Arena refusal source bound to
the active session's sole Operating Bond without publishing it. The
service signs EP-AGENT-RECORD-OBSERVATION-v1 before any database
mutation. The application-only creation capability authorizes one
database transaction, which rechecks the active adoption, latest bond,
and signed refusal source and inserts the immutable Agent Record. A
later failure leaves no partial record. Permit attempts cannot create a
record.

The browser generates and preserves the opaque record ID and owner token
before the request. The token controls only record revocation, is stored
only as a hash, and is never returned by the API. The request contains
no timestamp fields. An exact retry returns the original committed
record, projection, and timestamps even when the service computes and
signs fresh observation and retention timestamps. Conflicting reuse of
a record ID, owner credential, Arena source, or refusal digest fails.

In production this operation is available only when the operator
signing seed and key ID, durable Upstash limiter, server-side Supabase
configuration, matching private database creation capability, and all
Agent Record RPC entry points pass the runtime readiness gate. Public
errors never include dependency values or database details.

tool_signatures.name: createCloudApprovalPrototype

Experimental pre-standard prototype. Creates exactly one
`large_payment_release` receipt in enforce mode, binds the amount,
currency, counterparty name, payment destination hash, and payment
reference, and opens a one-hour signoff request for the named
`approver_id`. The response includes a server-computed `action_caid`
for `payment.release.1`. CAID identifies exact typed action content; it
does not establish authorization. The route refuses to continue unless
receipt creation requires Class-A assurance.

The returned `review_path` enters the WebAuthn/WYSIWYS Class-A review
flow. The plain bearer-key signoff decision routes are Class C and
cannot decide this request. Requires a tenant-bound Cloud bearer key
with `approval_request` or `admin`.

This route is not a production API, is not a certification program,
and is not an interoperability claim.

tool_signatures.description:
A provider timeout is recorded with `state=indeterminate` and no
evidence. INDETERMINATE is not retry-safe: the executor must not issue a
blind replay. A later `state=reconcile` request can resolve the operation
to EXECUTED or REFUSED only with an exact CAID-, digest-, operation-, and
consumption-nonce-bound `EP-MOBILE-PROVIDER-OUTCOME-v1` statement signed
by the exact Ed25519 executor key frozen at consumption and still active
for this organization. The signed provider statement is retained in the
protected server-side evidence store; bounded mobile exports carry only
its digest.

tool_signatures.name: recoverAgentAdoptionSession
tool_signatures.description: Uses the host's HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Strict adoption cookie or the explicit session bearer. The response excludes the bearer capability and permits same-browser continuation or revocation until the persisted session expiry.

tool_signatures.name: registerMobileExecutorKey
tool_signatures.description:
Admin-only endpoint. Registers a DER SPKI Ed25519 public key encoded as
base64url. `key_id` must equal the server-derived
`ep:executor-key:sha256:<hex>` identifier for the submitted key.

tool_signatures.name: requestSignoff
tool_signatures.description:
The authenticated receipt creator opens review for an unexpired receipt.
`approver_id` is required for a single-signoff receipt. When the receipt
carries a quorum policy, the server ignores a caller-selected roster and
fans out one request per approver already bound into that receipt.

tool_signatures.name: revokeAgentAdoption
tool_signatures.description: Revoke the adoption and every public projection

tool_signatures.name: revokeAgentRecord
tool_signatures.description:
The record-specific owner token is accepted only as an Authorization
bearer and is never returned in the public projection, URL, cookie, or
lookup response. One database transaction appends the terminal Agent
Record revocation; it does not create or mutate an Arena share and does
not rewrite the signed observation. An exact retry returns the original
terminal result.

Production revocation fails closed unless the operator signer, durable
Upstash limiter, server-side Supabase configuration, and all Agent
Record RPC entry points pass the runtime readiness gate.

tool_signatures.name: runGateControlPlaneScenario
tool_signatures.description:
Composes a synthetic executor-side Gate, an independently pinned network
observation, coverage evidence, and an evidence-eligibility decision. The
witness-only mode demonstrates the fail-closed boundary: observing traffic
does not establish that the action was mediated. All keys, effects, and
measurements are reference-only and make no production-system claim.

tool_signatures.name: runGateCoverageReferenceScenario
tool_signatures.description:
Runs the real source-inventory signing, verifier-owned context pinning,
exact CAID/action-digest join, conserving-count derivation, and
report-bound coverage attestation over synthetic records. It surfaces
one system-of-record effect without a matching Gate receipt. It proves
only reconciliation of the two supplied signed populations and makes no
source-completeness, production-payer, patient-record, or external-effect
claim.

tool_signatures.name: runGateReferenceScenario
tool_signatures.description:
Runs a synthetic consequential action through the real Gate runtime:
missing evidence is challenged, a generated human or quorum ceremony is
bound to the exact action, the authorized effect runs once, and drift,
tampering, wrong-authority, and replay presentations are refused. Keys
and effects are reference-only; this endpoint makes no production-system
or physical-world claim.

tool_signatures.name: runGraceReferenceScenario
tool_signatures.description:
Runs a synthetic 18 MW scenario through two Class-A mobile approvals,
bounded one-time dispatch, separately signed actuator and meter evidence,
an Action State COSE Signed Statement, one-time entitlement redemption,
and hostile replay cases. Cryptographic verification is real; the
adapters are simulations and this endpoint makes no physical-grid claim.

tool_signatures.name: stageReleaseLockDraw
tool_signatures.description: Requires write permission and payee-bound lien-waiver evidence for every exact payee.

tool_signatures.name: submitAgentAdoptionAttempt
tool_signatures.description: The caller selects one fixed attempt template; the server derives the target, amount, action, and verdict. No request reaches a provider or production executor.

tool_signatures.name: submitArenaAttempt
tool_signatures.description:
Atomically applies the session's synthetic occurrence and CREDITS
limits. The server derives the canonical action, action digest, CAID,
decision, and refusal reason. The client cannot supply a verdict.

tool_signatures.name: supersedeMobileAction
tool_signatures.description:
Operator endpoint that creates a successor revision and deterministic
added, changed, or removed material-field records. Supersession is
refused after execution authority has been consumed.

tool_signatures.name: verifyAgentAdoptionAssertion
tool_signatures.description: User presence and authenticator verification are recorded for the adoption-local credential. This is not identity, account authority, or authorization for later real actions.

tool_signatures.name: verifyAgentAdoptionRegistration
tool_signatures.description: Verify and store an adoption-only passkey

tool_signatures.name: verifyReleaseLockRegistration
tool_signatures.description: Browser-only mutation requiring the dynamic Release Lock cookie and an exact same-origin Origin header.

tool_signatures.name: withdrawMobileApproval
tool_signatures.description:
Accepts exactly an empty JSON object. Withdrawal is scoped to the
authenticated paired session and is refused after execution authority
has been consumed. It does not undo or compensate an effect.
